name: WA Travel and Accommodation Allowance for apprentices and trainees
provider: Department of Training and Workforce Development (WA)
summary: WA apprentices and trainees who travel over 70 km round trip to off-the-job training can claim help with travel and accommodation costs.
who: Apprentices and trainees who live in WA with an active or suspended training contract
Must travel more than 70 km round trip from home to the closest approved training provider
how: Claim through the TAA online client portal in WAAMS.
catches: Claims must be lodged within 60 days of the last day of each block training period or each day-release attendance.
Not available if your employer pays your travel and accommodation.

source.label: WA Government: Travel and Accommodation Allowance for apprentices and trainees

evidence.quote: must travel more than 70 kms (round trip) from their residential address
TAA claims must be submitted through the TAA online client portal
All claims for the TAA must be submitted within 60 days
